'''Muenster:''' {{legend0|#a5b0ff|40–50%}} {{legend0|#7996e2|50–60%}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Larry Pressler]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = [[Larry Pressler]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) | image_size = 150x150px | image2 = 3x4.svg | nominee2 = [[Ted Muenster]] | party2 = Democratic Party (United States) | popular_vote2 = 116,727 | percentage2 = 45.07% }} {{ElectionsSD}} The '''1990 United States Senate election in South Dakota''' was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] U.S. Senator [[Larry Pressler]] ran for re-election to a third term, beating Democratic nominee [[Ted Muenster|Theodore 'Ted' Muenster]] by 19,000 votes. This was the last time until [[2014 United States Senate election in South Dakota|2014]] that a Republican would be elected to South Dakota's Class 2 Senate seat. == Candidates == === Democratic === * [[Ted Muenster|Theodore 'Ted' Muenster]], former dean at University of South Dakota, former chief of staff for [[Richard F.
